info.title: Discordfy
info.summary: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to send rich messages to Discord channels through stored webhooks.
info.description: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to send rich messages to Discord channels through stored webhooks. Without arguments it opens the TUI; "discordfy mcp" starts the MCP server over stdio; any other command runs as a CLI with text or --json output.

command.name: discordfy
command.description: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to send rich messages to Discord channels through stored webhooks.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help for the current command and exit with code 0.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the version and exit with code 0.

options.name: --json
options.description: Return JSON output with the envelope { ok, command, data } or { ok, command, error }. Errors are JSON too.

options.name: --skill
options.description: Print the full documentation embedded in the binary, written for AI agents. With a topic, print only that section.

options.name: --opencli
options.description: Print the OpenCLI description (JSON) of the whole command tree.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI colors in text output. Same as NO_COLOR=1.

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send a rich message (text and embed) to a saved channel.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: Message text (up to 2000 characters). Optional when an embed or payload is given.

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read the message text from stdin.

options.name: --title
options.description: Embed title (up to 256 characters).

options.name: --description
options.description: Embed description (up to 4096 characters, Markdown accepted).

options.name: --url
options.description: Link opened by the embed title.

options.name: --color
options.description: Embed side color: #RRGGBB, decimal or a name (blurple, green, yellow, red, info, orange, grey...).

options.name: --field
options.description: Embed field, stacked. Repeat for more (up to 25).

options.name: --inline-field
options.description: Embed field shown side by side with other inline fields. Repeatable.

options.name: --embed
options.description: Extra embed as a JSON object or @file.json, appended after the one built from the flags. Repeat for more (up to 10 per message).

options.name: --author
options.description: Embed author line.

options.name: --author-url
options.description: Link of the author line.

options.name: --author-icon
options.description: Small image beside the author.

options.name: --footer
options.description: Embed footer text.

options.name: --footer-icon
options.description: Small image beside the footer.

options.name: --image
options.description: Large image at the bottom of the embed.

options.name: --thumbnail
options.description: Small image at the top right of the embed.

options.name: --timestamp
options.description: Embed timestamp: `now` (default when the value is omitted) or an ISO 8601 date.

options.name: --username
options.description: Overrides the webhook display name for this message. Default: send.username.

options.name: --avatar-url
options.description: Overrides the webhook avatar for this message. Default: send.avatarUrl.

options.name: --tts
options.description: Ask Discord to read the message aloud.

options.name: --thread-id
options.description: Post inside an existing thread of the channel.

options.name: --thread-name
options.description: Create a forum post with this title (forum channels only).

options.name: --payload
options.description: JSON body in the Discord webhook format (content, username, avatar_url, tts, embeds or the legacy single embed); `-` reads stdin. Options given on the command line override its top-level fields.

options.name: --silent
options.description: Deliver without push notifications; the channel only shows the unread badge.

options.name: --suppress-embeds
options.description: Hide the automatic link previews of URLs in the text.

options.name: --allow-mentions
options.description: Let @everyone, @here, roles and users in the text notify people.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the JSON body that would be sent and exit without calling Discord.

examples: discordfy send deploys --title "Deploy v1.4.0" --description "All checks passed" --color green --field "Branch=main" --inline-field "Time=42s" --timestamp

commands.name: webhooks
commands.description: Manage the Discord channel webhooks saved, encrypted, in ~/.discordfy/credentials.json.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Save the webhook URL of a channel. The URL is read without echo or from stdin.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: Channel name chosen by you: lower-case letters, digits, hyphen or underscore (e.g. deploys).

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read the URL from the first stdin line, even on an interactive terminal.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace the webhook when the channel already exists.

options.name: --no-verify
